invariants.invariant: The bridge does not kernel-check the imported proofs
invariants.rendering: *Dissolved by porting*: the results are re-proved in Lean here, so nothing is imported on trust. `Epistemic.SurfaceClaim.losslessness_always_holds` is the sharpest case — a receipt upstream, a theorem here

invariants.invariant: Source matching includes request identity and pinned hashes
Accepted results become scoped supporting evidence only
Absence is unresolved; only a certified negative may contradict
Truthy query semantics is not epistemic truth
Cross-ontology conflict requires explicit opposing evidence
Identity / external-ID / sitelink / lexeme results stay candidate evidence
invariants.rendering: `Wikidata.Identity.identity_does_not_entail_instance`; the bijection results are conditional on constraints (`functional_of_singleValue`, `injective_of_distinctValue`)

invariants.invariant: Diagnostics and pruning feed a review proposal, not an edit
Certified redundancy removal ≠ claiming a superclass is bad
Toy worlds are not claimed to have been executed by the real engine
invariants.rendering: *Dissolved by porting*: `Wikidata.Examples` runs the real QID fragment through the real checkers, by `decide`
